description.value: ManTung Cafe is a restaurant situated in a unit within a commercial complex on Alderbridge Way in Richmond, BC. It maintains an Instagram presence suggesting an active, community-facing operation. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond's city centre will find it a local dining option along a well-travelled corridor.
